Two rules cover most rows: .ph-btn (phone-states.css, radius 10px) and .ph-thread .finding-btn (findings.css, radius 10px). Change both to full-round.
The diff sheet also uses .ph-btn.is-narrow for text buttons, so the round More needs its own modifier (for example .is-round), not .is-narrow.
Back sits top left in every sheet, full and fit, because Android points back to the left and the system gesture comes from the edge.
The handle stays: it signals drag-to-close, and the existing swipe strip keeps working unchanged.
Smallest change: two CSS radii to full-round, one CloseIcon swap, one new .is-round modifier for bar More. Labels stay visible everywhere.
Cost: the bar stays docked, so the PR body loses 100px of height, same as today.
